title: The air of the Bordighera photograph of the hh tab (28 March 2026, 17:34 CET) and the rays traced through it over the globe and a plane

radius_enters_via.how: the globe's rays are traced over a 6,371 km sphere, to the 49 km great-circle distance of Villa Regina Margherita

verdict_rule: The plane would hide the 44.8 m the photograph hides with air the reanalysis allows, while the globe needs implausible air.
license_note: Weather: Open-Meteo (ERA5, Copernicus; marine), CC BY 4.0.

sources.cite: Open-Meteo historical weather API (ERA5) and marine API, 28 March 2026, three sea points at 43.5 N, 7.25/7.5/7.75 E

units.dT: K, air at 2 m minus sea surface
units.grad: K/m, mean between 0.5 m and the eye

inputs.origin: Open-Meteo historical weather (ERA5) and marine APIs, 28 March 2026, three sea points at 43.5 N (fog fetch ref-bordighera).

notes: The eye and the buildings are read from src/data/presets/hh-bordighera.js and hh-bordighera-photo.js (research/build_bordighera.py, fit_bordighera_photo.py), hashed into the preset's header.
